text: Which committee recommended the waiver of agricultural loans in 2008?
explanation: The Radhakrishna Committee (2007) studied rural credit and recommended loan waiver schemes that led to the 2008 Agricultural Debt Waiver Scheme.

text: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) was established in which year?
explanation: NABARD was established on 12 July 1982 under the NABARD Act 1981, replacing the Agricultural Credit Department of RBI.
